environment.note: 同一run内のbaseline/control/candidateを順序交代し中央値を比較。別run・別CPUの絶対時間は比較しない。オンラインGCC15.2とローカルGCC15.3を区別。

local_same_main.method: rotated independent processes, same main/I/O, CPU14 shared lock, median ms

online_short_case.conclusion: 同じmainで15回のローカル反復では増加は再現せず、5f6411fe版2.56ms対0ce794d7版2.67ms。オンライン単発差の原因は断定しない。

accepted.change: 最低ブロックを16KiBから32KiBへ拡大し、ブロックごとの素数走査と関数呼出しを減らす。実際の幅は平方根以上も維持する。
accepted.complexity: 構築O(limit log log limit)、全flags保持と単点判定O(1)は不変。追加確保なし。

summary.method: 5 rotated independent processes, same main/I/O, CPU14 shared lock, median ms

short_confirmation.method: same previously compiled binaries;21 rotated processes per variant per case;CPU14/sharedlock;medianms

full_main.note: main、共有入出力、SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS、コンパイラ設定を揃えたプロセス全体。出力と起動終了を含み、本体単独測定と区別。

limits: 境界の構築+countに0.3〜0.6%程度の小差あり。全条件で非退行とは主張しない。追加の個数集計・列挙・単点判定・追記処理は加えていない。

rejected.localized: 大規模1〜3%短縮だが262144 GCC native +2.8%、1M +1.3%。追加コードを伴うため不採用。

from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,concurrent.futures,fcntl,time,statistics,hashlib
p=Path(__file__).parent;r=Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env');f=json.loads((p/'frozen.json').read_text());sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
for n,h in f.items():assert sha((r/n).read_bytes())==h
main=(r/'Verify/current/drivers/eratosthenes_main.cpp').read_text().replace('#include "Verify/current/common/fast_io.hpp"',(r/'Verify/current/common/fast_io.hpp').read_text());(p/'main.cpp').write_text('#define SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS\n#include HEADER\n'+main)
headers={'current':p/'baseline.hpp','control':p/'baseline.hpp','previous':Path('/tmp/sirkit_sieve_412324_20261022/baseline.cpp')};flags=['g++','-O2','-std=c++23','-DEVAL','-DONLINE_JUDGE','-march=native'];commands=[]
for v,h in headers.items():
 cmd=['taskset','-c','8',*flags,'-DHEADER="'+str(h)+'"',str(p/'main.cpp'),'-o',str(p/('main_'+v))];a=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);assert a.returncode==0,a.stderr;commands.append(dict(variant=v,command=cmd,warnings=a.stderr))
files=Path('/tmp/sirkit_sieve_20261022/official/in');cases=['ten_02','ten_01','ten_00','max_00'];variants=list(headers);data={c:{v:[]for v in variants}for c in cases};reps={'ten_02':15,'ten_01':9,'ten_00':5,'max_00':5}
with open('/tmp/atcoder_full_performance_20261018/benchmark.lock','a')as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
 for rep in range(15):
  for ci,c in enumerate(cases):
   if rep>=reps[c]:continue
   shift=(rep+ci)%len(variants)
   for v in variants[shift:]+variants[:shift]:
    with (files/(c+'.in')).open('rb')as inp:
     start=time.perf_counter_ns();subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','14',str(p/('main_'+v))],stdin=inp,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,check=True);data[c][v].append((time.perf_counter_ns()-start)/1e6)
  (p/'main_results.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2))
summary={c:{v:statistics.median(values)for v,values in rows.items()}for c,rows in data.items()}
(p/'main_summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(flags=flags,builds=commands,source_hashes={v:sha(h.read_bytes())for v,h in headers.items()},frozen=f,method='rotated independent processes, same main/I/O, CPU14 shared lock, median ms',summary=summary),indent=2));print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
